title: NGSH Audit Ledger Entry
description: The shape of an entry in the tamper-evident audit ledger. The ledger is a hash chain: each entry commits to its predecessor, so a rewritten history breaks every subsequent hash (ADR-0005). This artefact exists because the entry structure is an assurance obligation and must be reviewable as a contract rather than living only in prose. The envelope fields (seq, hash, prevHash, timestamp) are added by the ledger service; the body below is the auditable content.

eventType.description: The kind of action being audited, e.g. 'access.decision.recorded', 'ingest.batch.accepted', 'reconcile.conflict.recorded'.

body.description: The auditable content. The fields present depend on the event type; the common shape is a subject, an action, a resource and an outcome.

subject.description: Who or what acted. Mirrors the envelope actor.

enforcementPoint.description: Which enforcement point produced the decision. ADR-0004 requires this so that the trail shows where a decision was made, not merely that one was.

anchorRef.description: Reference to the external anchor under separate administrative control, outside the NGSH boundary. A periodic anchor means that rewriting the whole ledger is still detectable.
